centralized_batch: all four patterns in fixed lexicographic order
coordinate_interface: physical at nonports; logical at every registered port
gate_requires: every centralized seed and every direct-local geometry/seed; finite final loss, weights, gradient and logits
incomplete_runs: preserve; remaining NOT_RUN; no retry or budget extension
short_distance_pool: source and destination logical IDs shared across geometries; 1-2 directed hops in both graphs
remote_pool: same destinations; both source distances >=5 in both physical geometries
